lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: It's the monthly meeting today. Everyone needs summary numbers: counts, totals, averages.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: Meet COUNT, SUM, AVG and GROUP BY. I've added a chapter to the handbook.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: One more thing: if someone asks for customers’ personal data, stop and think about who will receive it.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: The meeting went well thanks to your numbers. A per-branch summary beats thousands of rows.

lines.speaker: laras
lines.text: And remember: personal data isn't ours. It's only entrusted to us.
